# dotnet-1.28.0

## What Changed

[1.28.0] 2026 11 06 Added Foundry: Add the GA computer tool through FoundryAITool.CreateComputerTool() and carry computer calls and results through Foundry hosting, including batched actions. Add an Azure OpenAI computer use sample; the Foundry project endpoint still requires the existing preview tool. For non hosted GA loops, use stored response continuation: replaying locally retained computer calls with stored output disabled remains affected by an OpenAI SDK serialization limitation ( 8756 by @rogerbarreto). Foundry hosting: Add FoundryToolboxOptions.TokenScope for cloud specific toolbox authentication audiences, retaining https://ai.azure.com/.default as the default ( 10100 by @rogerbarreto). Changed A2A hosting: [BREAKING] Limit built in server registration to message based responses while reliable task resumption across hosts is deferred ( 10037 by @SergeyMenshykh). Migration: Remove assignments to the deleted A2AServerRegistrationOptions.AgentRunMode property. The built in handler now completes the run and returns a message rather than a task; update clients that expect task responses.
